## Verification

- [ ] `make check` passes (format, analyze, tests)
- [ ] Ran on a device/emulator with `--flavor dev`
- [ ] New behaviour has unit or widget tests

## Mobile checklist

- [ ] No secrets, API keys or signing material added to the repo
- [ ] Tokens and personal data stay in secure storage; nothing new is logged
- [ ] Network calls go through a repository and map errors to `ApiException`
- [ ] UI states covered: loading, empty, error, offline
- [ ] Accessible: labels on controls, tap targets ≥ 48dp, contrast checked
- [ ] Works on the smallest supported screen and with large text
